_note: Lesson 1.9, revised content approved by the author: looking at the journey, then at one work, then discovery. Existing screens are copied from lessons/unit-summary.html; new and changed screens were approved in chat. Source for tools/build-lesson-data.js.

description.he: נפרוש את כל העבודות שיצרנו לאורך היחידה ונראה מה השתנה ומה חוזר. אחר כך נתבונן בעבודה אחת, ונשאל מה גילינו על הדרך שלנו לצייר.
description.en: Lay out all the work made throughout the unit and see what changed and what keeps returning. Then look closely at one work, and ask what you discovered about the way you draw.

s.sub: לפי הסדר, מהראשונה ועד העבודה שפיתחתם בשיעור הקודם.

s.q1: מה אתם עושים היום שלא עשיתם בהתחלה?

s.sub: משהו שמופיע שוב ושוב, גם בלי שתכננתם.
s.ask: האם המוטיב שמצאתם באמצע היחידה עדיין שם?

s.poem:
זה לא חייב להיות ברור.
אבל זה שם.

s.big:
אם מישהו היה רואה את העבודות שלכם בלי השם שלכם,
איך היה מזהה שהן שלכם?
s.ph: אפשר לזהות את העבודות שלי לפי…

s.label: Unit Summary
s.big:
You finished a unit.
But what stays?

s.poem:
During the lessons
you paused,
looked,
and drew from yourself.

s.big:
Now we don't draw.
We just look.

Lay out all the work
from this unit.
s.sub: In order, from the first piece to the work you developed last lesson.

s.q0: Compare the first work with the last.
s.q1: What do you do now that you didn't do at the start?

s.sub: Something that appears again and again, even without planning it.
s.ask: Is the motif you found in the middle of the unit still there?

s.big:
Where in the drawing
do you see it?
s.sub: In the colour? In the line? In its place on the page?

s.poem:
It doesn't have to be clear.
But it's there.

s.label: Reflect
s.big:
What did you discover
about the way you draw?

If someone saw your work without your name,
how would they know it is yours?
s.ph: You can recognise my work by…

s.poem:
The drawing
doesn't end here.
It continues with you.
